Northern Sotho: Ba bangwe ba bolela gore balemi ba ka šomiša tšhelete ye ba e dirilego ge ba rekiša dinawa tša go šomišwa bjalo ka dihlare go ithekela dijo.
Amharic: ሌሎች ደግሞ ገበሬዎች ፊዚክስ ነትስ ሸጠው በሚያገኙት ገንዘብ ለራሳቸው ምግብ መግዛት እንደሚችሉ ይናገራሉ።

Source: In this study, the researchers wanted to know if it was actually profitable to grow Jatropha.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanooneyreza baayagla okumanya oba nga ddala okulima Ekiroowa kulimu amagoba.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwadìí yìí, àwọn olùwádìí fẹ́ láti mọ̀ bóyá ọ̀gbìn Jatropha ní èré lórí.
Zulu: Kululocwaningo abacwaningi bebehlose ukwazi ukuthi kungayenza yini inzuzo ukukhulisa i-Jatropha.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so sanin ko shuka Jatropha yana da riba.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go tseba ge eba go tloga go na le poelo go bjala Jatropha.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ ጃትሮፋን ማሳደግ በእርግጥ ትርፋማ መሆኑን ለማወቅ ፈልገዋል።

Source: They estimated how much money the farmers in northern Ghana could make if they planted Jatropha.
Luganda: Baatebereza ssente abalimi b’omu bukiikakkono bwa Ghana ze bayinza okufuna bwe balima Ebiroowa.
Yoruba: Wọn ṣe ìgbéléwọn iye owó tí àwọn àgbẹ̀ ní àríwá Ghana le è rí tí wọ́n bá gbin Jatropha.
Zulu: Baqangula nenani lemali elingenziwa abalimi basenyakatho yase-Ghana uma bengatshalai i-Jatropha.
Hausa: Sun ƙiyasta ko nawa ne manoman arewacin ƙasar Ghana za su iya samu idan sun shuka Jatropha.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba akanya gore balemi ba ka leboa la Ghana ba ka dira tšhelete ye kaakang ge ba ka bjala Jatropha.
Amharic: በሰሜን ጋና የሚኖሩ ገበሬዎች ጃትሮፋን ቢዘሩ ምን ያህል ገንዘብ ሊያገኙ እንደሚችሉ ገምተዋል።

Source: The researchers asked community leaders about the number of Jatropha farmers and the size of their plots.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baabuuza abakulembeze b’omu bitundu omuwendo bw’abalimi b’Ebiroowa n’obunene bw’ennimiro zaabwe.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí béèrè lọ́wọ́ àwọn adarí ìlú nípa iye àwọn àgbẹ̀ tí ó ń gbin Jatropha àti bí ilẹ̀ wọn ṣe tóbi sí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babuzwa abaholi bomphakathi ngobubanzi bomhlaba awabalimi abatshala i-Jatropha kanye nenani labo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun tambayi shugabannin al'umma game da adadin manoman Jatropha da kuma girman filayensu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba botšiša baetapele ba setšhaba mabapi le palo ya balemi ba Jatropha le bogolo bja dipholoto tša bona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ስለ ጃትሮፋ አልሚ ገበሬዎች ብዛት እና ስለ ቦታቸው መጠን የማህበረሰብ መሪዎችን ጠይቀዋል።

Source: They then used questionnaires to collect information they needed from farmers.
Luganda: Ate olwo ne bakozesa enkalala z’ebibuuzo okukuŋŋaanya obubaka bwe baali beetaaga okuva mu balimi.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn náà ni wọ́n wá lo ìwé ìbéèrè láti gba gbogbo ohun tí wọ́n nilò lọ́wọ́ àwọn àgbẹ̀.
Zulu: Babe sebesebenzisa imibuzo ehlelwe ukuthi izimvo zabantu ukuqoqa ulwazi ababelidinga kubalimi.
Hausa: Daga nan sai suka yi amfani da takardun tambayoyi don tattara bayanan da suke buƙata daga manoman.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba ile ba šomiša dipotšišo tša dinyakišišo go kgoboketša tshedimošo ye ba bego ba e hloka go tšwa go balemi.
Amharic: ከዚያም ከገበሬዎች የሚፈልጉትን መረጃ ለመሰብሰብ መጠይቆችን ተጠቅመዋል።

Source: They found that most farmers planted Jatropha in less than half a hectare.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti abalimi absinga baasimba Ebiroowa ku ttaka eritaweza kitundu kya heekiteya.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí i mọ̀ pé orí ilẹ̀ tí kò ju àbọ̀ ẹ́kítà lọ ni ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn àgb̀ẹ gbin Jatropha lé.
Zulu: Bathola ukuthi abalimi abaningi batshele i-Jatropha emhlabeni ongadlulile ngisho kuhhafu wobubanzi bezindawo zabo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa yawancin manoma sun shuka Jatropha a cikin ƙasa da rabin kadada.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba hwetša gore bontši bja balemi ba bjetše Jatropha nageng ya ka fase ga hekthara.
Amharic: አብዛኞቹ ገበሬዎች ጃትሮፋን ከግማሽ ሄክታር ባነሰ ቦታ ላይ እንደዘሩ አረጋግጠዋል።

Source: They also found that 85.5% of the farmers were males, 64% had livestock and only 2% of the farmers irrigated their farms.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu era baazuula nti ebitundu 85.5% eby’abalimi baali basajja, ate ebitundu 64% baalina ebisolo ate n’ebitundu 2% eby’abalimi baali bafukirira ebirime byabwe.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣe àwárí pé, ìdá 85.5% àwọn àgbẹ̀ jẹ́ ọkùnrin, ìdá 64% ní ẹran ọ̀sìn bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ìdá 2% péré nínú àwọn àgbẹ̀ ni wọ́n ń bu omi rin oko wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola nokuthi ama-85.5% wabalimi abantu besilisa, ama-64% unemfuyo, bese kuba ama-2% kuphela abalimi abachelela amapulazi abo.
Hausa: Sun kuma gano cewa kashi 85.5% na manoman maza ne, kashi 64% na da dabbobi sannan kashi 2% na manoma ne kawai suke ban ruwa a gonakinsu.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba hwetša gape gore 85.5% ya balemi e be e le banna, 64% ya bona ba be ba ruile gomme 2% ya bona ba hudušitše dipolasa tša bona.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም 85.5% ወንድ አርሶ አደሮች እንደነበሩ፣ 64% የእንስሳት እርባታ እና 2% አርሶ አደሮች ብቻ በመስኖ ማረስ መቻላቸውን አረጋግጠዋል።

Source: The researchers said that farmers who grew Jatropha, especially women, made less money per hectare than farmers of other crops.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti abalimi abaalima Ebiroowa naddala abakyala, baafuna ssente okuva mu buli heekiteya okusinga abalimi b’ebirime ebirala.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé owó tí àwọn àgbẹ̀ tí wọ́n ń gbin Jatropha, pàápàá àwọn obìnrin rí lórí ẹ́kítà ilẹ̀ kan, kéré sí èyí tí àwọn àgbẹ̀ tí ó ń gbin ohun ọ̀gbìn mìír̀n ń rí lọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi iningi labalimi abatshala i-Jatropha, kakhulukazi abesifazane babenza imali encane kakhulu ngehetha lilinye kunalo balimi abalima ezimye izinhlobo zezitshalo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce manoman da suka noma Jatropha, musamman mata, suna samun kuɗi kaɗan a kowace kadada fiye da manoman sauran amfanin gona.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore balemi bao ba bego ba bjetše Jatropha, kudukud basadi, ba dirile tšhelete ye nnyane ka hekthara go fetwa ke balemi ba dibjalo tše dingwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ጃትሮፋን አብቃይ ገበሬዎች፣ በተለይም ሴቶች፣ በሄክታር የሚያገኙት ገቢ ከሌሎች ሰብሎች ገበሬዎች ያነሰ ነው ብለዋል።

Source: This may be due to other factors like farmer or farm characteristics.
Luganda: Kino kiyinza okuba nga kiva ku nsonga ndala nga omulimi yennyini oba ebirala ebikwata ku nnimiro.
Yoruba: Èyí le è jẹ́ látàrí àwọn ìdí mìíràn bíi àbùdá àgb̀ẹ tàbí ti oko.
Zulu: Imbangela yalokhu kwakungaba izinto ezithi, okungaba nesidalo somlimi noma kube indlela ayiyo.
Hausa: Wannan yana iya zama saboda wasu dalilai kamar halayen manoma ko gonaki.
Northern Sotho: Se se ka bakwa ke mabaka a mangwe a go swana le semelo sa molemi goba seemo sa polasa.
Amharic: ይህም እንደ ገበሬው ወይም የእርሻ ባህሪያት ባሉ ሌሎች ምክንያቶች ሊሆን ይችላል።

Source: The researchers observed that farmers who hired farm workers, and those who were not scared of taking risks, were more likely to plant Jatropha.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza beetegereza nti abalimi abaalina abapakasi, ate n’abo abaali tebatya kuyingirira buzibu, baali basobola okusimba Ebiroowa.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí ṣe àkíyèsí àwọn tí ó ṣeé ṣe láti gbin Jatropha jẹ́ àwọn àgbẹ̀ tí wọ́n máa n gba àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ láti ṣiṣẹ́ fún wọn lórí oko wọn, àti àwọn tí kìí bẹ̀rù láti ṣe nǹkan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi abalimi ababeqasha abasebenzi nalabo ababengasabi ukuzama, babevame ukutshala i-Jatropha.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun lura cewa manoman da suka yi hayar ma'aikatan gona, da waɗanda ba su tsoron yin kasada, sun fi iya shuka Jatropha.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemogile gore balemi bao ba bego ba thwala bašomi ba polaseng, le bao ba bego ba sa tšhabe go itsenya kotsing, go be go na le kgonagalo ye ntši ya gore ba ka bjala Jatropha.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የእርሻ ሰራተኞችን የሚቀጥሩ ገበሬዎች፣ እና አደጋን ለመጋፈጥ የማይፈሩ ሰዎች፣ ጃትሮፋን የመትከል እድላቸው ሰፊ እንደሆነ አስተውለዋል።

Source: Members of a farmer organisation were also more likely to plant Jatropha, because they could get loans and assistance to manage the crop and find a market.
Luganda: Abalimi abaali mu bibiina by’abalimi era nabo baali basobola okusimba Ebiroowa kubanga baali basobola okufuna looni n’obuyambi obwandibayambye okukola ku kirime n’okufuna akatale.
Yoruba: Ó tún ṣe é ṣe kí àwọn àgbé wọhn wà ninú ẹgbẹ́ àgbẹ̀ láti gbin Jatropha, nítorí wọ́n le è rí owó yá, wọ́n sì le è rí ìrànlọ́wọ́ láti ṣe àkóso ọ̀gbìn àti láti ṣe ètò títa èrè oko náà.
Zulu: Amalungu ombuthwano waballimi nawo eyevamile ukutshala i-Jatropha ngoba ayekwazi ukuboleka amaloni nokuthola usizo lokulawula amapulazi awo, kanye nokuthola imakethe la eyedayisa khona lesi sitshalo.
Hausa: Mambobin ƙungiyar manoma ma sun fi shuka Jatropha, saboda suna iya samun lamuni da taimako don sarrafa amfanin gona da kuma samun kasuwa.
Northern Sotho: Maloko a mokgatlo wa balemi le ona go be go na le kgonagalo ye ntši ya gore ba ka bjala Jatropha, ka gore ba ka hwetša diloune le thušo ya go laola dibjalo tše le go hwetša mmaraka wa tšona.
Amharic: የገበሬ ድርጅት አባላትም ጃትሮፋን የመትከል እድላቸው ሰፊ ነበር፣ ምክንያቱም ሰብሉን ለማስተዳደር እና ገበያ ለማግኘት ብድር እና እርዳታ ስለሚያገኙ ነው።

Source: Farmers were more likely to plant Jatropha if they were in a district where they could easily sell their produce or had other organisations buying seeds for them.
Luganda: Abalimi era baali basobola okulima Ebiroowa bwe baba nga baali mu disitulikiti gye baali basobola okutunda ebirime byabwe oba nga balina ebibiina ebirala ebibagulira ensigo.
Yoruba: Ó ṣe é ṣe kí àwọn àgbẹ̀ tí ó wà ní agbègbè tí ó lajú gbin Jatropha, nítorí yóò rọrùn fún wọn láti la erè oko wọn tàbí kí wọ́n rí àwọn àjọ mìíràn tí wọn yóò ra erè oko lọ́wọ́ wọn.
Zulu: Abalimi babevamile ukutshala i-Jatropha uma besizifundeni lapho okwakulula ukuyidayisa izivuno zabo ,noma bekwazi ukudayisela eminye imibutho yabalimi imbewu.
Hausa: Manoma sun fi shuka Jatropha idan suna cikin gundumar da za su iya sayar da amfanin gonakinsu cikin sauƙi ko kuma wasu ƙungiyoyi suna siya musu iri.
Northern Sotho: Balemi go be go na le kgonagalo ye ntši ya gore ba ka bjala Jatropha ge e le gore ba be ba le ka seleteng seo ba bego ba ka rekiša ditšweletšwa tša bona gabonolo goba go na le mekgatlo yeo e bego e ba rekela dipeu.
Amharic: አርሶ አደሮች ምርታቸውን በቀላሉ የሚሸጡበት ወረዳ ውስጥ ከሆኑ ወይም ሌሎች ድርጅቶች ዘር የሚገዙላቸው ከሆነ ጃትሮፋን የመትከል እድላቸው ሰፊ ነው።

Source: These findings mainly showed that farmers who use their fertile lands for Jatropha instead of other cash crops don’t generate much profit because there are limited markets for the physic nut (its seeds).
Luganda: Okusinga ennyo, ebyazuulibwa byalaga nti abalimi abakozesa ettaka lyabwe eggimu okulimako Ebiroowa mu kifo ky’ebirime eby’essente tebafunamu magoba mangi kubanga birina akatale katono ak’empeke empamaanyi (ensigo).
Yoruba: Àwọn ohun tí wọn ṣe àwárí wọ̀nyí fihàn ní pàtó pé àwọn àgbẹ̀ tí wọ́n ṣe àmúlò ilẹ̀ wọn tí ó ní ọ̀rá fún ọ̀gbìn Jatropha dípò àwọn ohun ọ̀gbìn miíràn kìí ri èrè púpọ̀ nítorí kò sí àwọn oníbara púpọ̀ fún physic nut, (èso rẹ̀).
Zulu: Imiphumela iveze ukuthi abalimi ababetshala i-Jatropha emhlabeni wabo ovundile babevame ukungenzi inzuzo egculisayo ngenxa yokuthi yayincane kakhulu indawo la ababengakwazi ukudayisa kuyona imbewu yalesi sitshalo.
Hausa: Waɗannan sakamako sun nuna cewa manoman da suke amfani da gonakinsu masu albarka don Jatropha maimakon sauran kayan amfanin gona ba sa samun riba mai yawa saboda akwai iyakantacciyar kasuwa ta physic nut (ƙwayoyinsa).
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo tše di tloga di bontšhitše kudu gore balemi bao ba bego ba šomiša naga ya bona ye e nonnego go bjala Jatropha sebakeng sa go bjala dibjalo tše dingwe tša go tsenya tšhelete ga ba hwetše poelo ye ntši ka ge go na le mebaraka ye mmalwanyana ya nawa ya go šomišwa bjalo ka sehlare (peu ya yona).
Amharic: እነዚህ ግኝቶች በዋነኛነት እንደሚያሳዩት ለም መሬታቸውን ከሌሎች የጥሬ ገንዘብ ሰብሎች ይልቅ ለጃትሮፋ የሚጠቀሙ ገበሬዎች ብዙ ትርፍ አያገኙም ምክንያቱም ለፊዚክ ነት (ዘሮቹ) ገበያዎች ውስን ናቸው።

Source: The researchers recommended that Jatropha farming should be regulated so that only a small portion of fertile lands are used for this crop.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baasemba nti ennima y’eEbiroowa erina okulondoolwa, kibe nti ettaka ttono ddala eggimu eririmwako ekirime kino.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí gbàá ní ìmọ̀ràn pé kí ìfòfinde wà fún àwọn àgbẹ́ tí wọ́n ́ń gbin Jetropha, kí ìdá ilẹ̀ ọlọ́ràá tí wọ́n fi ń gbin ọ̀gbìn yìí le è kéré.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babeka umbono wokuthi ukutshalwa kwe-Jatropha kufanele kulawulwe ukuzi abalimi basebenzise inxenye encane yomlhaba ovundile ukutshala lesi sitshalo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa ya kamata a daidaita aikin noman Jatropha ta yadda za a yi amfani da wani ɗan ƙaramin yanki na ƙasa mai albarka don amfanin gona.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišinya gore go bjala Jatropha go swanetše go laolwa gore e be fela karolo ye nnyane ya dinaga tše di nonnego tšeo di šomišwago go bjala sebjalo se.
